filter.drop_reason: fewer than 5 MOp/MOs units after hemisphere subset

kinematics.right_camera_note: IBL right camera is 640x512, left is 1280x1024. Near-camera x/y on right-paw trials are multiplied by 2. Disparity z is rebuilt as x_near_scaled - x_far_scaled so both cameras speak left-camera pixels. Paw-state labels are NOT recomputed.
kinematics.speedNormalized: dlc_speedNormalized, lp_speedNormalized, and speedNormalized (Lightning Pose if present else DLC) = 2D speed divided by that session's median coupled speed for the same tracker and used_paw.
